This is stated in the amended clause 3.1 of the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement, which was amended by Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement [1].

Prior to the amendment, the original clause 3.1 also stated that the fee was invoiced on the first business day of each month [2].

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month

items.question: Which clause of the storage agreement did Amendment No. 1 replace?
items.answer: Amendment No. 1 replaced Clause 3.1 of the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement [1]. The original clause was replaced with a new provision specifying a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600 [1].

evidence.quote: amends the Storage Services Agreement dated 5 January 2026 between them
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: On what date did Jonas Ekberg give his witness statement?
items.answer: The documents do not state the date when Jonas Ekberg gave his witness statement.

items.question: What was Jonas Ekberg's job at Kestrel?
items.answer: Jonas Ekberg's job at Kestrel was that of a shift supervisor. This is stated in his witness statement, which says, "I was the supervisor on duty on the night the chiller in Hall 3 failed" [1].
